description: Quick Stats is the online database of official published aggregate estimates on U.S. agricultural production from the National Agricultural Statistics Service. Estimates come from hundreds of sample surveys each year covering virtually every aspect of U.S. agriculture and from the Census of Agriculture, conducted every five years with state- and county-level aggregates. Users query by commodity, location and period with keyword search, and a Quick Stats Lite interface gives commonly requested statistics. The Quick Stats API gives direct access after agreeing to the NASS terms of service and registering an email address for a key; requests use HTTP GET or JSONP and return up to 50,000 records, with a function to count records first. Access is free; coverage is national, state and county. No licence is stated on the pages read beyond the terms of service. Caveats: a single API request returns at most 50,000 records, and keyword search covers commodities only. For simulation it provides crop, livestock, price and farm economics statistics by county for exposure, agricultural loss and supply scenarios. Related catalogue records include the USDA Cropland Data Layer, USDA ERS data products and FAOSTAT.
